name: Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens
reviewed_by: phase 10b — every pool and every Chainlink feed READ LIVE before this file was written. All nine pools answered slot0(); all nine feeds answered latestRoundData(). Observed pool-vs-feed deviation across the nine: 0.040% (TSLA) to 0.244% (QQQ). Observed feed ages: 45 to 413 minutes. Those two measurements are what set dispute_tolerance_pct and feed_max_age_seconds below; neither is a guess.
note: The POOL decides the price, because the pool is where a trade actually fills. CHAINLINK decides whether to believe it. Trading against a Chainlink price would produce decisions that cannot be executed here; trading against an unchecked pool price would let whoever moves the pool decide what every agent believes. Token and pool addresses are the same values as services/signer/allowlist/robinhood-mainnet.json, and phase10-verify asserts the two files cannot disagree.
dispute_tolerance_note: The widest disagreement measured across all nine symbols was 0.244%, and some of that is the pool fee (5 or 30 bp) rather than error. 2% is roughly eight times the observed spread — wide enough that ordinary drift and a stale-ish feed never flap a symbol into dispute, tight enough that a pool moved far enough to matter is caught. Set from measurement, and it should be re-measured rather than re-guessed if the pools deepen.
feed_max_age_note: These feeds update on a long heartbeat: ages from 45 to 413 minutes were observed in one reading, all of them healthy. A limit below about 12 hours would mark normal behaviour as unrefereed and teach everyone to ignore the flag. 24 hours still catches a feed that has genuinely stopped, which is the failure this guards against — a dead feed answers cheerfully with its last value forever.
